title: Git hook timing record
description: Authored here (#66). One line of build/hook-timings.jsonl, appended by scripts/hook-timing for every run of a git hook in .githooks/ and summarized by `task hooks:timings`.

tasks.description: What the hook ran (pre-push: the affected-only selection, or ci:fast for the full pre-push gate).

duration_s.description: Wall-clock seconds the hook's work took.
